file-preview-run.description: Run a quick look previewer of this machine for one file or folder here, and return what it printed. The previewers come from [[quick_look.previewer]] in this machine's config.toml and from its enabled plugins. The caller sends only the path and the size: never a command. Over a link it needs files and open.

params.name: path
params.description: The file or folder. An absolute path, or one that starts with ~.

params.name: name
params.description: The previewer to run. Omit it to run the first one that matches.

returns.name: previewers
returns.description: The names of the previewers that match, in order. Empty when none does.

returns.name: run
returns.description: The run: name, output (ansi, text or image), data (base64), cut, exit, stderr, timed_out, missing. Absent when no previewer matches.

returns.name: size
returns.description: The size of the file in bytes.

returns.name: mtime
returns.description: When the file changed, in Unix milliseconds.
